landing.text:
HEADLINE
Achieve long-term financial stability

SUBHEADLINE
For retail investors, constantly checking market fluctuations, second-guessing investment decisions.

WHAT THIS IS
A guided onboarding assistant that explains risk, completes KYC, and helps new investors start their first SIP.

WHO IT IS FOR
Retail investors

THE PROBLEM
Constantly checking market fluctuations, second-guessing investment decisions

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Spreadsheets were not designed for retail investors, forcing manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Clear next steps eliminate emotional decision-making.

KEY BENEFITS
First-time investors start their first SIP without needing external guidance.

CALL TO ACTION
Start your index fund investment tracker

ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
index fund investment tracker helps retail investors understand risk, complete KYC, and start their first investment with confidence.

ONBOARDING
1. Answer a few questions to understand your financial situation.
2. Complete your verification so index fund investment tracker can personalise your plan.
3. Start your first investment and track your progress.

EMPTY STATE
1. No risk profile yet. Complete the questionnaire to get started.
2. No investments set up yet. Finish setup to see your plan.
3. No transactions yet. Make your first investment to see activity.

ERROR
1. That did not save. Check your input and try again.
2. That step did not complete. Make sure all required fields are filled in.
3. This action failed. Reload and try again, or contact support if it continues.

TOAST
1. Saved. Your progress is recorded.
2. Done. Continue when you are ready.
3. Profile complete. Your plan is ready.

BUTTON LABELS
1. Learn My Risk
2. Complete KYC
3. Start My SIP
4. Review Plan
5. View Portfolio
6. Confirm Details
7. Update Risk Profile
8. Track Progress

slots.empty_state: No portfolio tracked yet. Add your funds to start.
slots.helper_text: Enter your index fund details — what you own and why.
slots.error_message: Update failed. Check that all funds are correctly listed.
